en: I thought you'd locked it, Sergeant!
Enough! Quit passing the buck. Just throw them back in!
Try it and see!
Rushuang... the child's yours now... Forgive me...
D-don't worry... she'll... remarry soon enough...
You... you... ugh...
Got a ring of keys! Got a handkerchief!
All right, good grandson~ Let's get everyone out!
P-please stop calling me that! I am Huang Feihu, the Prince of Wucheng!
You said it yourself. Your own fault...
A tiger in the flats gets...
Did you say something? Come on, grandson~
Ah! You came to save me!
Ah! Beanpole came to save me!
Ah! Pingyan came to save me!
Gotta hurry and free the others!
Rescued by Beanpole, of all people. Unbelievable!
Exactly! What a shock! That flaky monkey-mouth actually did something useful? The sun must be rising in the west...
That's enough! If you're unhappy being rescued by me, go back to your cell! I'll pretend you don't exist...
Hmph! Fine, I'll go! Think I'm scared?
Bye! I won't see you out!
Leizhenzi! Now's your chance! Show some guts!
Go on, back you go~
Who do you think I am?! I'm Leizhenzi! You can't just tell me to go back!
Sigh~ What an utter disgrace...
Scared? Just say so, Beakface. Don't be shy...
All right! Enough, both of you! Let's get out of this mess before they come back. Oh, Pingyan, who's he?
He's my good grandson...
You...
Pingyan! Mind your manners...

I've long admired you, Prince Ji Fa. I'm Huang Feihu, Prince of Wucheng. King Zhou and Daji wronged my wife, so I broke with him. I was off to join the Lord of the West, but got ambushed and locked up here.
Your joining Xiqi's army would be a great blessing! And we owe our safe escape to your help, too...
Ha ha ha~ Oh, you're too kind! But it is true! Finally, someone sensible!
Oh, come off it! That cell wasn't even locked! Quit taking credit...
Pingyan~ Manners! Forgive my brother's rudeness, Prince.
You're too polite, my lord. I'd never stoop to a child's level. Once I join Xiqi, Chong Houhu, Zhang Guifang, whoever... none of them stand a chance...
How naive, thinking you could escape...
So you killed my men? Huang Feihu~
Monkey-face! Look how manly the Prince is!
Truly the world-famous Prince of Wucheng!
You misunderstand, General! These brats planned the whole escape, and they killed your men too! I warned them not to try anything, but I couldn't stop them... Go ahead and kill them! I won't mind...
What nonsense is that?! And here I thought you were a real man!
Listen, crazy lady! You never should have expected anything from this traitor...
I must've been blind...
Who're you calling a traitor? Don't slap that label on me! I only did it to lower their guard, so I could catch them off guard later...
So you planned to ambush me?
I just said so! Don't you get it? Huh!?
This dumb grandson...
Seize them all! Don't let a single one get away!
Yes sir!
Not good! The way things stand, we're no match for Zhang Guifang...
Hah!
Huh! Where'd they go?
That's Kunlun magic! I'll send troops after them at once!
I'll leave it to you, Zhang Guifang...
Men~ Follow me! We hunt down the Xiqi fugitives!
Yes sir!
Heh heh heh, if it isn't the Prince of Wucheng! Back already? Came to your senses, eh? Just surrender! You know you can't escape my grasp. Heh heh...
Quite right, my lord. That's why I'm back. And what's more, I've brought those brats back too!
Zhang Guifang, bring the hostages in...
Yes sir!
Nice going, grandson! You sold us out!
They're yours, my lord. Kill them, cut them, as you please...
Screw you, Prince of Wucheng! Jerk! Scumbag! Rotten turtle! Traitor!
I was so wrong about you!
Shut up, all of you! Yes, I tried to escape, but they forced me... Please see the truth, my lord...
Ha ha ha, say no more, Prince. I understand. When we return to court, I'll put in a good word for you with King Zhou. Rest easy!
Then I thank you in advance, my lord!
Not at all, not at all...
Oh, and General! While I was away, I happened upon a rare treasure. Please accept it as a humble gift!
Ha ha ha, let's have a look...
Prince of Wucheng! What is this...
P-please spare me! This was all the brats' idea, nothing to do with me! They wanted me to assassinate you here... I refused at first, but they said they'd skin my grandson if I didn't... I...
So you were about to assassinate me!? You've been lying from the start?
Huh!? Wait... so if I hadn't said anything...
The idiot spilled everything again...
I said this grandson was useless! Nobody listened!
Men! Seize him!
Yes sir!
C-curse you... long live King Zhou...
Ha ha ha~ See that? That's my true power! Ha ha ha~
Ugh~ Curses... how could I...
Hmph! Like it's all his credit... If not for the Golden Scissors...
Quit griping, Beakface!
B-but he nearly got us killed...
Well, it all worked out. Let's hurry back and report to Pa!
Yeah, don't sulk, Leizhenzi... You did pretty well too...
R-really? Miss Yang Jian!
Ha ha ha~ Ha ha ha~ Behold my power! The way I am now, I fear neither Grand Tutor Wen nor King Zhou! Ha ha ha~
So this is the famous Prince of Wucheng... ...............
Isn't that Huang Feihu, Prince of Wucheng?
K-King Zhou, please don't take that seriously! I was only joking...
Ha ha ha~
Waaah~ Even Uncle couldn't avenge Father... Then what's the point of staying in this world all alone...
Father... brothers... Zhuzhu's... coming... to you...
Men! Take her back!
Grand Tutor, is that wise? We're on King Zhou's secret orders...
That is an order!
Yes sir!
Take her back for treatment and lodge her at my estate. I go on to Xiqi. You need not follow!
But...
Hm?
As you command!
Our Xiqi army turned defeat into victory, and it's all thanks to you here!
Aw Pa, don't mention it! Ha ha...
Oh! Father, allow me to introduce Jiang Ziya, prized disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun. When we were in danger, he helped us escape...
Yuanshi Tianzun's disciple! Thank you for saving my sons. Please accept my bow...
Please rise, my lord! It was nothing. Truth be told, for my friend Ancient South's sake, I owe your sons a few bows myself! Ho ho ho...
Ha ha ha~ Now both Huang Feihu and Jiang Ziya have joined us! With such able allies, we can face King Zhou's army and protect the people of Xiqi! Ha ha ha, what a happy day...
Able allies? Grandpa, sure, but that useless Huang Feihu counts as a fighter?
Shh! Shh!
Leizhenzi, my boy, did you say something?
No, he didn't say a thing!
Rest easy, my lord! With me, Huang Feihu, guarding Xiqi, no evil force will ever set foot inside... Ha ha ha~
What's with all the sighing, young man...
Oh, it's you, Grandpa...
Thinking of someone, eh?
Heh heh... can't hide anything from you, Grandpa. Two childhood friends of mine are still missing. Ancient South said if I help you finish the Investiture, I can go back to my own world...
I see! So that's why Master told me to find the General Star. That's why you came to this era!
You know about the General Star too? What IS it? What's it got to do with me? Why is it the reason I'm here?
Ho ho ho! You'll know when the time comes!
Not again! Grandpa, seriously!
Don't worry! You'll get back to your own time!
Don't you believe me, young man...
No! It's not that, Grandpa! It's about me... This battle showed me I'm only half-baked. If I meet someone stronger than Zhang Guifang, I'll be...
Seeing your own shortcomings is the first step to success. The worst thing in life is never seeing your weaknesses. If you're truly worried, Grandpa could take you as his disciple!
Well...
Is Grandpa not good enough for you?
N-no way! Grandpa... I mean, Master...!
Ha ha ha ha~ My good disciple...
Though I haven't much time left to teach you...............
Did you say something, Master?
I said it's late. Go get some rest.
Yes, Master~
Grandpa... you...
Little Miss Yang Jian......
So you saw......
Why not tell him the truth? You're already......
Every meeting is fate. I sought the Way all my life; an heir at the end is enough! Please don't trouble Pingyan with this. You're good kids. It's late, off to bed!
Young lord! Wake up~ Assassin! His Lordship's been attacked!
P-Pa's been attacked... I'm on my way...
Bro! You're here! Hurry, Pa's been attacked!
What's eating you, Beanpole?
......Relax! The Lord of the West will be fine...
......I know that. I'm just wondering, if we do find the assassin, can we even beat him?
Beanpole! Scared? That's not like you!
B-but even Master was no match...
Monkey-face! Stop it! I can't stand hearing this! Sure, maybe all of us together are no match for the assassin, but are you going to give up without even trying?
Miss Yang Jian is right. Pingyan~ United, brothers can cut metal! Together we'll find a way!
Hey, lighten up! If there's danger, I, Huang Feihu, Prince of Wucheng, will protect you!
Protect us? We'll thank heaven if you just don't drag us down!
S-silence! Last time I was just nervous, and the plan wasn't thought through...
Ha ha ha~ Fine! I'll trust my good grandson one more time! Let's go!
That's more like you, Monkey-face!
Hmph! You've got nowhere to run! Give up quietly!
Ho ho ho... I've been waiting here quite a while...
Hmph! Surrounded, and still talking big! Let me, Huang Feihu, take you down a peg!
Insolence!!
G-G-Grand Tutor Wen!!
Grand Tutor Wen!?
Prince of Wucheng~ You wish to oppose me?
G-Grand Tutor... w-why would I... I'd never oppose you, Grand Tutor...
Get lost!
Y-yes! Getting lost right now!
That guy's totally useless! Right, Beanpole?
Long time no see! Yan~
Yin Wen!
Yin Wen? Ho ho ho~ Nobody's called me that in ages! Now they call me Wen Zhong, Grand Tutor Wen!
Grand Tutor Wen? What's going on? What happened to you in this era? Where's Xiaojun? Where is she, Yin Wen!

You don't need to know. I am now the Shang's top state advisor. For old times' sake, kill these rebels beside you and surrender to King Zhou, and I promise you wealth, glory and a fine title! How about it?
Have you lost your mind, Yin Wen?

Lost my mind? Ho ho ho~ I've never been clearer. Since coming here I've become Wen Zhong, second only to the king! I've never felt so confident. Coming to this world was the best thing ever! Don't you agree, Yan~
What are you talking about? Weren't you happy back home? You're brilliant, top of the class, and you had me and Xiaojun as childhood friends! What more did you want?
You've got some nerve saying that! Back home, however hard I tried, I always lost to you, big or small, even with Xiaojun... I'm done being second best... Look how glorious my life is now~
......Wait! Master and Pa... was that you......? You're the assassin!?
No! I'm no assassin. I am Wen Zhong, State Advisor of Shang, sent by royal decree to crush the Xiqi rebels! That feeble old fool was your master? Ji Pingyan, oh Ji Pingyan! I really pity you!
Wake up, Yin Wen!
Prepare to die, Xiqi rebels!
Y-Yin Wen... when did you... get this strong...?
Ha ha ha ha ha! I am the invincible Grand Tutor Wen! Yan... for old times' sake, one more chance! Kill these rebels and come back to Zhaoge to serve King Zhou!
No way!!
What did you say?
Whatever path you take is your choice! But whatever you choose, you'll always be my friend... Dying at a friend's hand, I'd have no regrets! But betray my friends for glory? No way!
Ji Pingyan.........
Then die, Ji Pingyan~
Come to Zhaoge, Ji Pingyan~
P-Pingyan... are you all right...
M-Master! You... you'll be okay, right?
I must go now... What weighs on me most is the Investiture my master entrusted to me...
You can't die! History says you finish the Investiture and even become prime minister of the new dynasty...
Ho ho ho... The General Star may have changed history...
D-did I do this to you, Master?
Pingyan, never say that... At the very end of my life's journey, I got to meet you... I'm truly happy......
M-Master...
Pingyan... may I ask one thing of you?
Not just one! I'll do a hundred things for you...
My one regret... is failing the Investiture Master gave me...
Master! Don't worry! I'll finish it for you!
You really are my good disciple...
My... my body is filling with power?
P-Pingyan... I have... poured my lifetime... of training... into you... The God-Whipping Rod... and the Investiture... are yours now... Ping...yan.........
Master!
I'm so... glad... I met you.........
Master----!!
Even Jiang Shang is dead... What now?
Jiang Shang, meant to finish the Investiture, dead halfway?
Even I can't say whether the three General Stars bode good or ill. Perhaps only time will tell...
Ji Chang, traitorous Lord of the West! By King Zhou's command, I, Chong Houhu, Lord of the North, am here to crush you rebels!
You're mistaken, my lord! I'm no traitor; I simply won't let anyone harm the people of Xiqi... Chong Houhu! Withdraw today, and I'll bind my own hands and go to Zhaoge to beg the king's pardon!
Ji Chang! You take me for a three-year-old? Today I'll take your head and drown Xiqi in blood!
Then you leave me no choice..................
A night's stay is 20 silver.
How can I help you?
A night's stay is 20 silver.
Got summon beast Wuyun Camel!
Ugly! How many times must I tell you? Stop following me! What are you, a ghost bound to this place? Want me to hire a priest to exorcise you?
Chanyu~ Don't say that~ I didn't get the phoenix bone, but Tu Xingsun really, really likes Chanyu! And Chanyu likes Tu Xingsun too, right?
Get away from me! Ten meters back!
Oh! Got it!
How many times must I say it, Ugly? Since the day I met you I've just been using you! I never liked you!
I know that's not true.
Must I say it twice? I never liked you, Ugly! Not before! Not now! And never ever in the future! There, I've said it all! Now go!
Father just got word that the Lord of the West has rebelled. I'm off to Xiqi to wipe out the traitors. I'm warning you! Stop following me! Scram!
Chanyu......
Scram, I said! Or I'll chop you up and feed you to the dogs!
Waaah~
Chanyu... Chanyu's a dummy... Waaah~
She must know this trip is dangerous and fears I'll get hurt, so she... drove me away on purpose! That's it! I'm so touched! Chanyu must like Tu Xingsun! I'll protect you in secret...
Welcome to Jiulong Town!
Jialong Mountain ahead marks the Xiqi-Zhaoge border!
I hear King Zhou sent Chong Houhu and Zhang Guifang against Xiqi, but the Lord of the West's son beat them!
They say a demon fox is sealed on Jialong Mountain. Wonder if that's true...
From Jiulong Town, Jialong Mountain's north, Jiulong Cave's east, Xuanyun Cave's west and Jushan Manor's south!
Those wretched Four Fiends! If only I knew magic...
Will no one stop the Four Fiends? Heavens~
State Advisor Wen Zhong is so cool! When I grow up I wanna be just like him!
Legend says Xuanyun Cave holds Sibuxiang, a summon beast of wondrous power!
This time the victim is Xiaoshen! Poor girl...
Sigh! The stars foretold it, and fate won't bend. Jiang Shang is gone.
Life is fleeting; all things are fated.
What do we do... I won't allow it! I'll never hand Xiaoshen to the Four Fiends!
Waaah~ Even if you object, what can we change?

On Jiulong Island is Jiulong Grotto, home of four sorcerer brothers. They've used their magic to bully us for years, and every season we must offer them a beautiful girl or they'll curse us... Waaah~ The deadline is tomorrow! What do we do...
That's just despicable!

I will NOT allow anyone to use magic to oppress villagers, let alone force them to hand over girls! No way, no how! Monkey-face~ Gather all the villagers. I've got a brilliant plan to nail these four bastards!
Miss Yang Jian~ Are you sure about being offered up in Xiaoshen's place?
Don't worry! If anything happens, I'm sure big brother Leizhenzi~ will protect little me, right?
Of course! Leave it to me, Miss Yang Jian~
No need to worry about her, Beakface~ Ever heard the saying? Cross a wolf or a tiger, but never cross a shrew! This crazy lady's way stronger than you.
Crazy lady again? Getting tired of living, Monkey-face?
The altar is ready. The rest is up to you!
Okay, okay, truce. The villagers are ready, they're just waiting on you.
Hmph!
Ooh~ If it isn't little Miss Yang Jian! Ho ho ho~ Searched high and low, and here you fall into my lap! By King Zhou's orders, I'm here to arrest you rebels!
Get lost! I've got no time for you right now, Mrs. Tu~
Don't lump me in with that ugly freak!
Quit yelling "ugly freak" nonstop! A nasty old hag like you is the real ugly freak!
Y-you... prepare to die!
Ugh... you... rotten hag!
Ho ho ho~ Yang Sen! The villagers are wising up this time... She's a looker!
Let's go, Wang Mo!
Halt! You two demons! Let go of Chanyu right now!
U-Ugly... why didn't you leave...
Hang on, Chanyu... I'm coming to save you...
Ugh... ugh...
Ha ha ha~ Shorty~ With those flimsy moves you wanna play hero? Come back when you've grown up!
Ha ha ha~ For that bizarre courage of yours, I'll spare you! Let's go, Wang Mo!
Ch-Chanyu... I'll... save you... I swear...
Miss Yang Jian? Where are the Four Fiends? Huh? Isn't that the phoenix bone thief?
What's up? Why so quiet?
Argh!! Those two blind bastards! I was the offering! And they said that hag was prettier!
So Deng Chanyu got taken by the Four Fiends...
Don't tell me you just stood there and watched?
Of course!
That's cold!
What was that, Monkey-face? She was sent by King Zhou to arrest us! Being dragged off as the Fiends' bride is letting her off easy...
True, but......
But what?
I-I, Tu Xingsun... have a big favor... to ask... Please... help me save Chanyu...
Are you kidding? You know she was sent by King Zhou to arrest us?
I... I know that... If you... help me save Chanyu... I'll be... your servant for life... at your command...
Worry about your own wounds first! Saving people, really!
That hag treats you like dirt, and you still do this?
As long as she's okay... nothing else matters...
I get it! Go rest up first. Don't worry about Deng Chanyu. We're heading to Jiulong Island!
Thank you... little brother... My wounds are nothing... I'm coming... to Jiulong too...
If you insist, then let's go!
Hmph! I'm only doing this for Tu Xingsun's sake! I'm NOT going out of my way to save her!
Yeah, yeah! Let's go!
You said you're going to Jiulong Island? The Four Fiends put a barrier on Jiulong Grotto. Until you get the summon beast Sibuxiang from Xuanyun Cave, you can't break the seal!
Xuanyun Cave, huh? Thanks! We'll head out now!
Xuanyun Cave is to the west!
If my daughter hadn't been given to the Fiends, she'd be Xiaoshen's age now... Waaah~ Xiaolan......
Legend says Xuanyun Cave holds Sibuxiang, a summon beast of wondrous power!
Xiaoming worships the State Advisor lately. Wants to be that great when he grows up!
We need Sibuxiang first to break Jiulong Grotto's barrier!
There's a barrier here! Can't get in...
You must be Sibuxiang! We need your power to break the seal on Jiulong Island!
First show me your strength. Let's see if you're worthy to be my master!
Got summon beast Sibuxiang!
This is wonderful!
Never thought the Four Fiends would end up like this!
Wonderful! Now we're free of the Four Fiends' threats!
Without your help, my Xiaoshen would've been the Four Fiends' victim!
Waaah~ This is so wonderful...
Thank you! Thank you so much! Here's a little something.
Got 5000 silver!
Thank you!
Huh! Why does this village look like a ruin?
I think I hear a girl crying!
Hmph! Your ears perk up for girls' voices.
Ho ho ho... But never for that tomboy Yang Jian, huh! Ha ha ha~
Y-you hag! What did you say?
Hit a nerve, did I? Ho ho ho...
I-is that true?
As if! Why would I want that unevolved monkey-mouth to notice me...
I thought so...... heh heh......
Let's go find whoever's crying!
Beanpole must've scared her off...
More like your weird crow-beak face scared her off!
Hmph! Let's just go in and look!
Yes sir! Crow~ Beak~
Waaah~ Who are you? Stay back...
Don't worry! We're not suspicious people... Why is Jushan Manor deserted? Looks abandoned for a while...
Waaah~ A few months ago, a man-eating demon suddenly came to Jushan Manor. To save me, my parents hid me under the bed... and they both... I watched as my parents were... Waaah... Papa... Mama...
That's unforgivable...... Tell you what! We'll avenge them!
R-really? Waaah... thank you... I've prepared a feast. If you don't mind, please join me!
Then don't mind if we do......
Beanpole... why do I feel so weak...
M-me... too...
Ugh... me too...
Ling'er, you... you...
Ha ha ha~ You fools! I am Lady Shiji of Jin'ao Island~ Sent by the State Advisor to take your lives!
What... did you say? Yin Wen... sent you?
Ho ho ho ho ho ho... I ate everyone in this village. Tomorrow night is the full moon. If I eat you then, my power will soar! Ha ha ha~
Dream on! I won't let you do it!
H-how did you... My Ten-Fragrance Limp Powder... no one can resist it...
Your act was flawless, but you slipped up. One: you reek of blood. Two: why was the feast ready beforehand? Like you knew we'd come by!
Ho ho ho... Clever! You saw right through me!
Prepare to die!
Th-this is the Celestial Feather Robe!
Ho ho... So young, yet you know the Celestial Feather Robe, treasure of Jin'ao!
C-curses... this isn't working...
You rotten hag! You... you ran off and left us! Traitor!!

That hag has the Celestial Feather Robe, said to repel blades, spears and magic. As long as she wears it, nothing can hurt her...... What do I do? Tomorrow's the full moon. If I can't think of something, Monkey-face and the others will.........
Got it! Master once said only Taiyi of Mount Qianyuan has treasures that can pierce the Feather Robe: the Cosmic Bow and Heaven-Shaking Arrows! And Mount Qianyuan's not far! I'm off to find Taiyi!
